selectiveTransferBatch.fingerprintContract: Group upstream transfer rows in original iteration order by condition.frame+'|'+model; sort each row's cells lexicographically by samples.join(',') using ASCII comparisons; record [[p,q,rate,ms],cells.map(x=>[x.samples,x.mass.map(q),q(x.confidence),q(x.oracleCorrect)])] where q(null)=null and q(x)=Math.round(1e8*x). Hash compact ASCII JSON of the group. Python independently integrates each deletion over exact rational intervals, then applies independent discrete shift probabilities. Fingerprints cover cell keys, deletion masses, nominal confidence and oracle correct mass at 1e-8 quantization; not bytewise whole receipts or every curve/decision. V8 check: 54 nominal tied cells, all chose first tied index. Exact rational certainty summaries match observed V8 numerical results.
selectiveTransferBatch.exclusions: Full legacy CLI also requires index.html, phase-fit.cjs, matched-fp.cjs; --with-reconstruction additionally invokes joined-workbench.cjs and its six pinned modules. Those detector/operating/reconstruction paths, generated package manifest, HTML launch, physical audition and Windows not qualified in this run. Waveforms depict true onsets; shift is feature-domain only. Finite equally weighted synthetic conditions, no human evidence, no new license.
